title: Iron Bisglycinate Supplement 29 mg
abstract:
As a dietary supplement, take one (1) Iron Bisglycinate Supplement vegetarian capsule daily or as directed by your health care professional.
Iron Bisglycinate Supplement from Cooper Complete helps support healthy circulation, immune health, and energy production.† Iron is a mineral that lives in every cell in the human body, yet it is the most prevalent mineral deficiency.
In studies comparing this form of iron to other rock-salt forms (most commonly ferrous sulfate), the Ferrochel® patented form of iron shows absorption rates 59 percent higher than ferrous sulfate. Ferrochel® iron also shows fewer adverse complaints compared to ferrous sulfate. Subjects at 30 mg per serving (Cooper Complete Iron Bisglycinate Supplement is 29 mg per serving) reported no complaints of side effects.
Cooper Complete Iron Bisglycinate Supplement is formulated with Ferrochel® Ferrous Bisglycinate Chelated iron formed by binding iron to two organic glycine molecules. The patented chelation process leaves Ferrochel® iron ionically neutral, so it doesn’t block the absorption of other nutrients.
As a dietary supplement, take one (1) Iron Bisglycinate Supplement vegetarian capsule daily or as directed by your health care professional.
